The record shows matching at 08:40:00 and the rider's cancellation at 08:46:40, i.e. 6 min 40 s (400 s) after matching, which is more than the 3-minute free-cancellation window [F4][NS-4]. The $6.61 fee charged on record therefore stands [F7][NS-4].

The rider's stated reason — "plans changed and the driver had not even arrived" — is not a ground for waiver under NS-4: the rider's remedy for dissatisfaction is a RydeHELP appeal under NS-7, and Ryde publishes no free-cancellation rule for late-arriving drivers [F10][NS-4]. In any event the driver was within 200 m of the pickup from 08:41:25 and stationary 41 m away from 08:42:00 until the cancellation, having tapped "I'm Here" at 08:42:15 from 40 m, so the "not even arrived" premise is factually wrong [F1][F2][F3][F6][NS-4]. This also explains why the driver-side no-show branch is irrelevant: the trip was cancelled by the rider, not by the driver, so NS-1/NS-2 do not apply [F4][NS-0].

No refund or waiver follows: the fee is a Ryde-published cancellation fee, so FARE-1 is not breached [F7][FARE-1]. No account flag is warranted: the driver's here-tap was taken 40 m from the pickup, well inside range, and the two chat messages are complete and timestamped, so no NS-2 abuse condition is met [F6][F11][NS-2]. events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your dispute about the $6.61 cancellation fee has been reviewed. The decision is that the fee stands and no refund will be issued. The facts that decided it: you cancelled more than 3 minutes after a driver was matched to you, which is past the free-cancellation window, and the driver had already arrived at the pickup point and was close by before you cancelled. This means the fee was correctly charged. Ryde publishes no free-cancellation rule for a driver arriving late, so the fee is not refundable as a Ryde voucher or otherwise. Your account is not being flagged and nothing changes on it. You can still appeal through RydeHELP if you have new information.

DRIVER: Your side of this cancellation dispute has been reviewed. The decision is that the $6.61 rider cancellation fee stands, and you keep the fare as normal — no rider refund applies. The facts that decided it: the rider cancelled more than 3 minutes after matching, past the free-cancellation window, and your arrival at the pickup point is on record, so the cancellation was the rider's, not a driver no-show. This means no penalty or review is applied to your account and nothing changes on it. No further action is needed from you.
